name: Performance running shoe
summary: The shoe made for distance running. It has a light nylon mesh and suede upper, a foam midsole, a waffle or lugged rubber outsole, and a raised, cushioned heel.

philosophy.core_thesis: A running shoe is a tool. Every part, from the weight to the heel height, is set by the way the foot lands and the number of kilometres it runs.
design_principles: Keep the shoe under 300 g in a men's size 9, and cut weight before decoration.
Build the upper from nylon mesh with suede reinforcement at the toe and the heel.
Mould the midsole from EVA foam, 2 to 3 cm thick at the heel and thinner at the forefoot.
Set the heel 8 to 12 mm higher than the forefoot, and flare it for a heel strike.
Mould a waffle or lug pattern into the rubber outsole for grip.
Add a padded collar and tongue for comfort at long distance.
Add reflective trim and a visible stripe for the road.
anti_patterns: A leather upper that does not breathe
A narrow toe box that squeezes the foot

silhouette.shape: A low, wedge-shaped shoe: a flared heel, a rounded toe box and a bold side stripe.
silhouette.line: A line that slopes up from toe to heel, with a swoosh or a stripe along the side.
silhouette.fit: Snug at the heel and the midfoot, roomy in the toe box, with a padded collar.
silhouette.proportion: Heel height 25 to 35 mm; forefoot height 15 to 25 mm; mass under 300 g.
rules: Make the heel wider than the arch.
Place a stripe or a mark on the side.
Keep the upper to a few panels.
Use contrast colour on the heel counter.

fabrics.rule: Use nylon mesh and thin suede for a light, breathable upper, EVA foam for the cushion and a rubber outsole for grip. Use leather for a heavy training shoe only.

methods: suede overlays stitched at the toe and the heel
EVA foam midsole moulded in a press
construction.closures: Flat or round laces through 7 to 8 eyelets, with a padded tongue.
construction.details: A side stripe, a flared heel, a waffle sole, a padded collar, a reflective trim and a heel tab.

surface.pattern: Colour blocks and a side stripe in a contrast colour; fine mesh in a single bright colour.
surface.gloss: Mesh and suede at 2–10 GU; foam and rubber at 10–30 GU.
surface.wear: The shoe loses its cushion after 600 to 800 km; worn midsole foam and a flat tread show the end of its life.

palette.strategy: Bright colour blocks on a white base, with a contrast stripe and a dark outsole.

processes: testing for wear in the lab
making.scale: From a workshop, with a waffle iron and a handful of pairs, to a global factory output of millions.
making.signs: A light mesh, an even and clean foam midsole, a flared heel and a precise stripe.

pieces.form: Trainer with a nylon mesh upper and a suede toe
Training shoe with a suede upper and a stripe
Racing flat in ripstop nylon with a screen-printed stripe
Cushioned trainer with a thick foam midsole
Training shoe with a microfibre suede overlay

emotion.target_response: A feeling of effort and lightness: a shoe that stands for fitness, speed and work with the body.

use_cases: a sports or fitness product brief
a note on the history of cushioning
avoid_when: the brief wants a dress shoe
the brief wants a canvas retro shoe

modifiers.how: Move to leather panels, add a bold colour block and a heavy brand mark, and raise the sole.
Replace the mesh with canvas and the foam with a flat rubber sole.

ornament_level.note: Ornament is a stripe, a colour block and a reflective trim.
